question: Mohan can complete a piece of work alone in 6 days by working 5 hours a day, and Rohan can do the same in 8 days. If they work together for 8 hours each day, how long will it take them to finish the work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mohan: 6 days × 5 hr = 30 hr ⇒ rate = 1/30 per hr

Rohan: 8 days × 5 hr = 40 hr ⇒ rate = 1/40 per hr

Combined rate = 1/30 + 1/40 = (4 + 3)/120 = 7/120 per hr

Time = 120/7 hr ⇒ per day (8 hr) ⇒ (120/7) ÷ 8 = 2(1)/(7) days

**∴ Answer = 2(1)/(7) days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mohan: 6 days at 5 hr/day; Rohan: 8 days at 5 hr/day; Together: 8 hr/day

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mohan time = 30 hr, Rohan time = 40 hr

⇒ LCM = 120 units

⇒ Efficiency: Mohan = 4, Rohan = 3

⇒ Combined = 7 units/hr

⇒ Total time = 120 ÷ 7 hr

⇒ In days = (120 ÷ 7) ÷ 8 = 2(1)/(7) days

**∴ The correct answer is 2(1)/(7) days.**
